name: StarCraft S2
description:
🔥 StarCraft Survival — Pure Survival Vibes 🔥

Ek asli vanilla survival experience jahan skill hi sab kuch hai! 💥

⚔️ Features:

🪓 Mace + Wind Charge combos — full working, fresh combat meta

✨ Crit hits enabled — har hit mai skill dikhao

🐾 Animals & mobs — proper vanilla vibe, koi shortcuts nahi

👥 Gang system — apni team banao, apna territory banao

⚡ Player PvP — survival mai raaj karna hai to fight karna padega

📲 Supported Versions: MCPE 0.14.3 & 0.15.10

🚀 Aur bhi bohat kuch aane wala hai future mai... stay tuned!

StarCraft Survival mai sirf building nahi, real survival hoti hai — trust karo, banao, ya fight karke le lo!
